name: Columbia (STS-32)
about: Columbia (STS-32) (1990-002A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1990 Jan  9. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1990 Jan 11), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW22); its coordinates are written from memory
